sources.title_en: OpenAI reports AI "research interns" and warns about its own pace at the same time

sources.summary:
OpenAI reports that AI agents in its own research already handle 3.1 workdays for every human workday, and it says it has reached its goal of an "automated research intern." But chief scientist Pachocki warns that no lab has a good enough grip on alignment and monitoring to keep scaling at maximum speed.

stories.title: 在UBS，AI技能已成为求职的必备条件。 / At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job

sources.title: 在UBS，AI技能已成为求职的必备条件。 / At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
sources.title_zh: 在UBS，AI技能已成为求职的必备条件。
sources.title_en: At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
sources.title_original: At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
sources.summary:
Swiss banking giant UBS is making AI skills a required qualification from 2027 for graduates and interns in Global Banking and Markets, with applicants having to show in interviews how they use AI to improve outcomes and efficiency. Santander is already looking for advanced AI users too, while Morgan Stanley predicts more than 200,000 banking jobs in Europe will disappear within five years.
Swiss banking giant UBS is making AI skills a required qualification from 2027 for graduates and interns i
sources.recommend_reason_zh: UBS宣布2027年起，AI技能成为毕业生与实习生录用条件，面试须展示如何用AI提升效率；Morgan Stanley预测欧洲超20万银行岗位五年内消失。

5. 在合适的启蒙年龄，一定要教孩子计算机和 ai、生理卫生相关知识。
6. 至于语文、地理、政治、历
